newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Abu Dhabi awards June 4-6 jet at 10 cents premium.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi awards June 4-6 jet at 10 cents premium.

text.p: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co (ADNOC) has sold by tender 25,000 tonnes of jet fuel for June 4-6 lifting at 10 cents per barrel above spot Middle East quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis, traders said on Monday.
The tender closed on May 9 and bids were valid until May 12.
In its last tender, ADNOC sold 25,000 tonnes of jet fuel to a U.S. trader at a premium of 25 cents above MidEast quotes for May 14-15 lifting, fob basis.
Separately, traders said ADNOC had also sold on spot basis a similar sized jet fuel cargo for mid-June lifting at a premium of between 20-25 cents to a trader for export to India.
